titleEnglish: Taajdar E Haram — Maqbool Ahmed Sabri

verses.ar:
Taajdaar-e haram ho nigaah-e karam
Ham ghareebon ke din bhi sanwar jaaen ge
verses.en:
O King of the Holy Sanctuary, grace us with your merciful gaze
Even the days of us poor ones will be set right

verses.ar:
Qismat men meri chain se jeena likh de
Doobe naa kabhi mera safeena likh de
Jannat bhi gawaarah hai magar mere liye
Ay kaatib-e-taqdeer madeena likh de
verses.en:
Write into my fate a life of peace and contentment
Write that my vessel shall never sink
Heaven too would be acceptable — yet for me
O Writer of Destinies, write Madina as my fate

verses.ar:
Haami-ye be-kasaan kya kahega jahaan
Aap ke dar se khaali agar jaaenge
verses.en:
O Protector of the helpless — what will the world say
If we leave your door empty-handed?

verses.ar:
Koyi apna nahin gham ke maare hain ham
Aap ke dar pe faryaad laaye hain ham
Ho nigaah-e karam warna chaukhat pe ham
Aap ka naam le le ke mar jaaenge
verses.en:
We have no one — we are stricken with grief
We have brought our cries to your door
Grace us with a merciful glance — or at your very threshold
We will die crying out your blessed name

verses.ar:
Kya tumse kahoon ay arab ke kunwar
Um jaante ho man ki batiyaan
Dar furqat-e to ay ummi-laqab
Kaate nah kate hain ab ratiyaan
Tori preet mein sudh-budh sab bisri
Kab tak yih rahegi be-khabari
Gaahe ba-figan duzdeedah nazar
Kabhi sun bhi to lo hamri batiyaan
verses.en:
What shall I say to you, O Prince of Arabia?
You already know the matters of my heart
In separation from you, O bearer of the title Ummi
The nights no longer pass as they used to
In love for you I have lost all awareness
How long will this state of oblivion last?
Cast at least a stolen glance my way
Won't you listen to my words just once?

verses.ar:
Aap ke dar se koyi na khaali gaya
Apne daaman ko bhar ke sawaali gaya
Ho habeeb-e hazeen par bhi aaqa nazar
Warna auraaq-e hasti bikhar jaaenge
verses.en:
No one has ever left your door empty-handed
Every supplicant left with their mantle filled
Cast your gaze upon this grief-stricken lover too, O Master
Or the pages of my existence will be scattered to the wind

verses.ar:
Mai-kasho aao aao madeene chalen
Aao madeene chalen
Isi maheene chalen
verses.en:
O seekers of the wine of love, come — let us go to Madina
Come, let us go to Madina
Let us go this very month

verses.ar:
Tajalliyon ki ajab hai faza madeene mein
Nigaah-e shauq ki hai intiha madeene mein
Gham-e hayaat nah khauf-e qaza madeene mein
Namaaz-e ishq karen ge ada madeene mein
Ba-raah-e raast hai raah-e khuda madeene mein
verses.en:
A wondrous atmosphere of divine manifestations fills Madina
The yearning gaze finds its fulfilment in Madina
No grief of life, no fear of death in Madina
We shall perform the prayer of love in Madina
The straight path — the path to God — is in Madina

verses.ar:
Dast-e saaqi-yi kausar se peene chalen
Yaad rakkho agar uuth gayi ik nazar
Jitne khaali hain sab jaam bhar jaaenge
verses.en:
Let us go to drink from the hand of the cup-bearer of Kawthar
Remember — if just one glance is lifted our way
Every vessel that is empty shall be filled

verses.ar:
Khauf-e toofaan hai bijliyon ka hai dar
Sakht mushkil hai aaqa kidhar jaaen ham
Aap hi gar na lenge hamaari khabar
Ham museebat ke maare kidhar jaaenge
verses.en:
The storm terrifies us, we fear the lightning
We are in great difficulty — O Master, where shall we turn?
If you yourself will not enquire after us
Where shall we afflicted ones go?

verses.ar:
Ya Mustafa ya Mujtaba irham lana irham lana
Dast-e hamah be-chaara ra, daamaan tu-hi
Man aasi-yam man aajiz-am man be-kas-am haal-e mara
Pursaan to-yi pursaan to-yi
verses.en:
O Mustafa, O Mujtaba — have mercy upon us, have mercy upon us
Yours is the cloak that all the helpless grasp
I am a sinner, I am weak, I am without support — you alone know my state
You alone enquire of me, only you

verses.ar:
Ay mushk-bed ambar-fishaan
Paik-e naseem-e subh-dam
Ay chaarah-gar eesa-nafas
Ay moonis-e beemaar-e gham
Ay qaasid-e farkhundah pah
Tujh ko usi gul ki qasam
In nalti ya reeh as-saba
Yauman ila ard il-haram
Balligh salaami raudatan
Feeh an-nabi yul-mohtaram
verses.en:
O bearer of musk fragrance, O scatterer of amber
O messenger of the morning breeze
O healer with the breath of Isa
O companion of those sick with grief
O bearer of blessed footsteps
I swear to you by that rose
O morning breeze, carry this
One day to the sacred land
Deliver my salutations to the blessed garden
Where rests the honoured Prophet
